interactives.label: Rules of the stair
interactives.text: One party at a time. The waves come down to you; the stair behind stays quiet once you have cleared it. Fall and you rise at the last fire you passed. The waystones count you out.

interactives.label: Waystone
interactives.text: The waystone home. Using it counts you out of the run.

interactives.label: The prospectors' seep
interactives.text: A thread of meltwater the miners panned for silver. They found more here than in the mine.

interactives.label: The silver miners' strongbox
interactives.text: The road's cache. It opens once for each of you when the court is quiet.
